title: Closing and Funding Returned-Wire Interest Refund
content:
## The refund

A returned-wire refund returns the prepaid interest a funded Closing and Funding closing collected for the lost days of a Larkspur-side return, the days the loan went unfunded because Larkspur's own wire came back.

The refund is owed as soon as the loan has funded; interest for the lost days of a Larkspur-side return is refunded as a returned-wire refund where Larkspur bears returned-wire interest (Yes under every closing method), and an unfunded day that is not a lost day is refunded under the rules for funding late, never as a returned-wire refund. A charge that already carries a returned-wire refund is not refunded again for a returned wire.

The refund entry names the charge collected at closing, records the daily amount used and records its period as the lost days counted from the first lost day.

## Booking tool and how it is invoked

The refund is booked with the agent-side tool `refund_returned_wire_interest_891dcbc9`: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call adds one refund entry, marked as a refund for a returned-wire delay, to the closing's prepaid interest ledger, dated today, and reduces the closing's prepaid interest balance by the refund amount in the same step. The borrower can see the refund entry and the lower prepaid interest balance.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `closing_id` | reference number of the closing and funding engagement whose prepaid interest is refunded, as returned by the closing lookup | identifier |
| `source_interest_entry_id` | reference number of the prepaid interest charge entry this refund corrects, as returned by the prepaid interest ledger lookup for that closing | identifier |
| `interest_from_date` | earliest refunded day of interest | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `interest_through_date` | latest refunded day of interest; the same as the earliest refunded day when a single day is refunded | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `daily_interest_amount` | per diem amount at which each refunded day is returned | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `interest_amount` | total refund amount | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive figure rounded half up to the cent |

The tool records the number of refunded days itself, both ends counted.

**Return.** A confirmation naming the new refund entry reference number, the closing reference number, the refunded period with its day count, the per diem amount, the refund amount and the closing's resulting prepaid interest balance; the presence of the new entry reference number indicates the refund was booked.

Hypothetical: with a first lost day of the 26th and 4 lost days, the entry's period runs from the 26th through the 29th.
